basis: Papilloma originates in the respiratory mucosa of the sphenoid sinus.
Malignant neoplasm of the retina; lymphoma is only one subtype of this umbrella concept.
Developmental disability and skeletal abnormalities define the syndrome; renal dysplasia or urinary obstruction occurs in 30-79%. Listed cardiac defects occur in 5-29%.
Primary malignant mesenchymal tumour of the liver.
Hepatic fatty-acid oxidation disorder; supplied phenotypes report neurologic dysfunction and muscle atrophy at 80-99%. Renal and cardiac lesions are occasional.
Oxidative phosphorylation defect; encephalopathy, cardiomyopathy and myopathy reported in 80-99%. Cap omits renal tubulopathy, optic damage and hearing loss, also reported in 80-99%.
Neuroendocrine tumour originates in the middle ear; neuroendocrine histology alone does not establish endocrine gland disease.
Congenital absence of enteric ganglia throughout the intestine directly affects intestinal function and its peripheral neural apparatus.
Immune-mediated inflammatory muscle and skin disease; interstitial lung disease affects roughly one-third or more of adults.
Congenital distal joint contractures and deformities of the hands and feet define the disorder.
Cryoglobulin-mediated vascular inflammation or occlusion; many cases are asymptomatic. Persistent skin, renal or nerve damage is not established in >=30% across this umbrella.
Disorders directly affecting the pleura; infection is only one subtype.
Skeletal muscle dystrophy; reduced vital capacity reflects respiratory muscle weakness. Frequent cardiovascular abnormalities are unspecified and do not establish direct cardiac damage.
Skin and skeletal overgrowth; intellectual disability 80-99%, cataract/retinal detachment 30-79%. Cap omits vascular involvement (30-79%); parathyroid dysfunction unspecified.
Carcinoma of the lip or oral cavity; the mouth belongs to the gastrointestinal axis.
Nonsyndromic sensorineural hearing loss, present in 10/10 annotated patients.
NMDA receptor-related neurodevelopmental disorders defined by developmental impairment, epilepsy and other central nervous system dysfunction.
Premature fusion of cranial bone sutures; common direct neurologic damage is not established for this umbrella concept.
Carcinoma originates in minor salivary glands, which belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Despite the susceptibility wording, the definition specifies familial pancreatic carcinoma; pancreatic tumour origin establishes the gastrointestinal axis.
Immune-mediated joint disease attributable to Behcet syndrome; this manifestation concept does not establish additional systemic organ damage.
Intellectual disability and developmental delay define the disorder; feeding difficulties alone do not demonstrate gastrointestinal damage.
Inherited cholesterol/bile-acid metabolism defect; cholestasis, hepatitis and hepatic steatosis reported in 80-99%. Atherosclerosis is a separately diagnosed downstream disease.
Immune-mediated inflammatory disease directly affecting the intestine.
Methionine metabolism disorder; definition explicitly describes hepatomegaly and elevated transaminases without liver disease. Neurologic problems are a risk, not established common damage.
